summary: The CorrespondenceGeneratedQueue is a system designed to manage and process correspondence within the HSPnet application. Its main functionality revolves around handling reports, email communications, and various user interactions within a web-based UI system.
purpose: The primary purpose of the CorrespondenceGeneratedQueue is to manage the scheduling and processing of reports and correspondence generated within the system. It provides functionalities for viewing, delivering, and managing reports, as well as handling email communication.

workflows.name: Report Viewing and Emailing
steps: Load the page and initialize view settings based on session variables.
Select reports using checkboxes and control parameters.
Submit actions such as marking reports as viewed, delivered, or emailing.
Use JavaScript methods to manage UI interactions like expanding or collapsing report details.
Handle errors and warnings using panels and labels.

workflows.name: Data Binding and Refresh
steps: Refresh data based on user actions or page events.
Bind data from ObjectDataSource to UI components.
Update view based on selected filters and actions.

business_rules: Reports must be marked as delivered or viewed based on user input.
Emails must go to default or selected recipients.
Users must be able to toggle visibility of report details.
validations: Ensure all selected reports have a recipient before emailing.
Validate if reports can be marked as delivered based on status.
conditions: Check for post-back to determine if page elements need refreshing.
Toggle report group visibility based on user actions and session cookies.
system_behavior: Autogenerate fields and controls based on designer configurations.
Use JavaScript to manage UI interactions.
exceptions: Handle null or undefined options when iterating through checkbox lists.
Display warnings if no recipients are available for emails.
